verdict.rationale: Supabase is built directly on Postgres and exposes native Postgres capabilities rather than an abstraction layer: real extensions like pgvector and pg_graphql, native RLS, Postgres-native Cron and Queues (via pgmq), and direct Postgres connection strings for any client. This is corroborated by community discussion of RLS being genuine Postgres RLS (with real learning curve) rather than a simplified proxy. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks/case studies confirming drop-in compatibility for existing Postgres apps/tooling, and no MySQL/SQLite dialect support is claimed or relevant (Supabase is Postgres-only).
